challenge.method: Compared the two SPDX headers with the Exhibit B text present in both full license bodies. Checked whether Mozilla sections 1.5 and 10.4 support treating every appearance of Exhibit B as an initial contributor's election.
challenge.results: Only this entry adds the incompatibility notice to its header. Under section 1.5(a), the initial contributor attaches the notice to Covered Software. Section 1.5(b) independently covers software previously made available under MPL 1.1 or earlier without a Secondary License. Section 10.4 requires attachment when distributing incompatible Source Code Form under MPL 2.0. The common document's exhibit establishes neither an attachment nor its cause for any project.

limitations: The finding establishes identifier usage in SPDX License List 3.29.0. A particular work's grant, notices, licensing history and eligibility under MPL section 3.3 require separate evidence.
The SPDX comment describes the effect of Exhibit B on the secondary-license route in section 3.3. Mozilla's provisions govern that route.
